data.narrative:
Scout AI is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in defense technology, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method uses the $15M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $38M. The Peer-Median method examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), yielding a median of $1.0B across the sample.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $32M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $519M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding Scout AI's positioning relative to the peer set. Stage-Progression anchors to realized capital and assumes standard progression mechanics; Peer-Median reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security valuations, where Series A companies in this sector command multiples ranging from 8x to 267x the Seed stage baseline. Key uncertainties include the company's technical differentiation, customer pipeline visibility, and trajectory relative to earlier-stage peers like UFORCE (valued at $1.0B) versus later-stage companies spanning $125M to $4.0B.
